personalInfo.headline: Backend Developer | Building Scalable, Secure & Efficient Server-Side Systems | Skilled in Spring Boot, MySQL & REST APIs
personalInfo.about: I’m a backend developer who loves building structured, efficient, and scalable systems that make applications work smoothly behind the scenes. I specialize in Spring Boot, MySQL, and deploying projects using Render. I enjoy solving real-world problems through clean backend logic, database design, and well-tested APIs. I’m continuously learning how to make backend systems more optimized and reliable — from managing data flow to integrating services seamlessly. I also use GitHub for version control and collaboration, ensuring every project is organized and production-ready.

experience.description: Completed comprehensive training at Profound Edutech, where I learned to develop dynamic and scalable web applications using Java Full Stack technologies. Gained hands-on experience with: Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React; Backend: Core Java, Advanced Java, Spring Boot; Database: MySQL; Tools & Concepts: REST APIs, Git, and Project Deployment.
Completed internship training in C programming language, focusing on problem-solving and algorithmic thinking.

education.degree: Bachelor of Technology - BTech, Computer Science and Engineering

projects.title: Smart Traffic Management System
projects.description: An AI-powered traffic control system that adjusts signals based on real-time vehicle detection. Highlights: -YOLOv8 + OpenCV for detection & counting -Arduino Nano-controlled LED signals -Physical prototype simulating real-life traffic.

projects.title: Social Forensic AI Tool
projects.description: An AI tool for detecting offensive/hate content from social media datasets. Highlights: -Data collection & preprocessing for NLP model training -Content classification & filtering -Python-based implementation with open-source datasets.
